X1.crossing.hint: Read the smallest budget whose seed-mean energy distance stays under 0.01 at that budget and every larger one.
X1.crossing.label: the crossing budget

X10.n_above_gate.label: the number of molecules clearing the 0.5 gate

X10.swap_pair.hint: Give the two design indices as digits, lowest first, for example '13'.
X10.swap_pair.label: the pair of designs that swap

X11.trend.label: the direction of the trend with length

X2.confound.hint: One sampler is a deterministic ODE solve; the other draws fresh randomness at every reverse step.
X2.confound.label: the named confound

X2.direction.hint: Hold the sampler family fixed with DDIM at eta=0 and compare against flow matching at the same budget.
X2.direction.label: the direction of the gap

X2.factor.hint: The eta=0.0 seed-mean divided by the eta=1.0 seed-mean.
X2.factor.label: the cost of removing the sampling noise

X2.floor.hint: Draw two independent target samples of the same size and measure the energy distance between them.
X2.floor.label: the two-sample floor

X3.ratio.label: the ratio of the two crossing budgets

X4.saturation.label: the smallest budget where validity has saturated

X5.hetatm.hint: Count lines whose first six columns read HETATM.
X5.hetatm.label: the HETATM count

X5.max_closest.hint: Every ligand overlaps the reference ligand, so both organic-cofactor checks would fail for every one of them.
X5.max_closest.label: the largest closest approach

X5.n_under_06.label: the number of ligands within 0.6 angstroms

X5.pb_if_retained.hint: Every ligand overlaps the reference ligand, so both organic-cofactor checks would fail for every one of them.
X5.pb_if_retained.label: the fully-valid count had the caffeine been retained

X6.div_rdkit.hint: Chem.RDKFingerprint at library defaults, after Chem.RemoveHs.
X6.div_rdkit.label: the RDKit topological diversity

X6.n_pairs.hint: Twenty molecules give 20*19/2 unordered pairs, not 20.
X6.n_pairs.label: the number of pairs averaged over

X7.strain.hint: Look at how PoseCheck builds its relaxed reference ensemble.
X7.strain.label: the strain classification

X9.cent_within5.label: the count of re-docked centroids within 5 angstroms

X9.pb_generated.label: the fully-valid count for the generated poses

X9.pb_redocked.label: the fully-valid count for the re-docked poses

X9.within2_any.label: the count within 2 angstroms allowing any returned pose

X9.within2_top.label: the count within 2 angstroms on the top pose
